summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K containing a London Stock Exchange announcement dated 3 August 2026 regarding director/PDMR share transactions under Article 19 of the UK MAR. Group CNO Alberto Ripepi sold 1,000,000 ordinary shares at £1.21696 each for £1,216,960 on 30 July 2026; a person closely associated with Non-Executive Director Stephen Carter acquired 2,961 shares via a DRIP at £1.183225 on 31 July 2026. This is routine insider dealing disclosure, not a special situation; no strategic event, deal terms, or board action involved. Watch: no investment implications; merely standard compliance reporting.
